title: What's New in Sustainability (2024 release wave 2)

features.name: Sustainability Manager Role Center
features.description: New dedicated role center for sustainability managers featuring KPIs, daily emissions tracking, goals, baselines, targets, and charts showing emissions by scope and gas type.
features.status_evidence_quote: try to test all these features in preview as the majority of them actually all all of them except demo data will
caveats: User must have 'sustainability manager' field marked to be scorecard owner

features.name: Sustainability Scorecards and Goals
features.description: Feature to define multiple sustainability scorecards and goals with baseline tracking, current values, and target values for emissions. Only one goal per company can be marked as main goal.
features.status_evidence_quote: try to test all these features in preview as the majority of them actually all all of them except demo data will
caveats: Only one main goal per company
Baseline calculated from sustainability entries in previous period

features.name: Emissions in Purchase Documents
features.description: Ability to enter emissions directly in purchase orders and invoices, linking sustainability accounts and tracking emissions by gas type without requiring separate sustainability journal entries.
features.status_evidence_quote: try to test all these features in preview as the majority of them actually all all of them except demo data will
caveats: Must be enabled in sustainability setup under procurement fast tab
Optional for users not requiring sustainability features
Emissions calculated per unit of measure

features.name: Carbon Equivalent Recalculation
features.description: Automatic recalculation of different greenhouse gases to carbon dioxide equivalent using configured emission factors and coefficients.
features.status_evidence_quote: try to test all these features in preview as the majority of them actually all all of them except demo data will

features.name: Internal Carbon Fee
features.description: Capability to configure and calculate internal carbon fees per emission type with support for different countries and responsibility centers, enabling financial impact tracking of emissions.
features.status_evidence_quote: try to test all these features in preview as the majority of them actually all all of them except demo data will
caveats: Can be configured per country, responsibility center, or company-wide

features.name: Emission Fees Page
features.description: New page and table for configuring carbon fees and carbon equivalent factors by emission type, with date ranges, country, and responsibility center dimensions.
features.status_evidence_quote: try to test all these features in preview as the majority of them actually all all of them except demo data will
caveats: Allows retroactive updates of carbon fees for existing entries via 'Update Carbon Fees' function

features.name: Purchase Credits
features.description: Ability to purchase and track carbon credits within purchase documents to immediately decrease emissions in the system.
features.status_evidence_quote: try to test all these features in preview as the majority of them actually all all of them except demo data will
caveats: Carbon credits must be marked as greenhouse gases credit on items

features.name: Sustainability Entries in Financial Reports
features.description: Integration of sustainability ledger entries into standard financial reports, allowing visibility of sustainability data alongside financial information.
features.status_evidence_quote: try to test all these features in preview as the majority of them actually all all of them except demo data will

features.name: Sustainability Certificates on Vendors and Items
features.description: New fields for tracking sustainability or city certificates on vendor and item master data.
features.status_evidence_quote: try to test all these features in preview as the majority of them actually all all of them except demo data will
caveats: Type is auto-populated based on where certificate is created from

features.name: Updated Demo Data Tool
features.description: Enhanced demo data tool to include all new sustainability features and updated scenarios for the 2024 release wave 2.
features.status_evidence_quote: not in major this is something what will come in 25.1 we will update demo data tool

features.name: Purchase Document Sustainability Visibility Filtering
features.description: Users working with sustainability see only sustainability-related purchase documents in tiles, filtered based on sustainability setup enabling.
caveats: Requires enabling usage of purchase document sustainability setup

features.name: Emissions Entry with Sustainability Accounts
features.description: Users can add sustainability account numbers to purchase invoices and enter emissions data for different gases with automatic per-unit-of-measure calculation.
caveats: Can enter emissions for multiple gases or single gas as needed
System calculates per unit of measure automatically

features.name: Sustainability Ledger Entries with Document Tracking
features.description: Posted sustainability documents create ledger entries showing document type, emissions details, and full transaction information in find entries view.

features.name: Carbon Credit Item Configuration
features.description: Items can be marked as greenhouse gases credits with sustainability fast tab settings to define unit of measure conversion for automatic emission calculation on purchase.
caveats: Requires setting unit of measure in item card matching sustainability setup tracking unit

features.name: Automatic Carbon Credit Offset Posting
features.description: Posted carbon credit documents automatically create sustainability ledger entries with negative emission values without manual entry of minus signs.

features.name: ESG Reporting with Financial Row Definition
features.description: Financial reports now support sustainability totaling types using sustainability accounts, carbon equivalent and carbon fee amount types for emissions reporting.

features.name: Hybrid Financial and Sustainability Reporting
features.description: Reports can combine sustainability entries with statistic accounts and financial posting accounts to calculate metrics like emissions per employee and emissions per revenue.
caveats: Future CSRD and regulatory reports will expand this capability
